#030 · Poison Pin Pokémon

Nidorina

Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Nidorina is a Poison-type Poison Pin Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 20 kg. It evolves from Nidoran♀ and into Nidoqueen. Its highest base stat is HP (70), with a base stat total of 365.
